content: .{@-धरः, -धारः@} .²1 ‘the thread-holder’, a stage-manager, the principal actor who arranges the cast of characters and instructs them, and takes a prominent part in the Prastāvanā or prelude; he is thus defined:-- नाट्यस्य यदनुष्ठानं तत् सूत्रं स्यात् सबीजकम् . रङ्गदैवतपूजाकृत् सूत्रधार इति स्मृतः .. .²2 a carpenter, an artisan. .²3 the author of a set of aphorisms. .²4 an epithet of Indra.
